blocks.text: Let's solve this one step by step. Three times the bracket two plus four times the quantity five minus three squared, close bracket, minus seven.
Work from the inside out. In the innermost group, the exponent comes first. Three squared is nine.
Then five minus nine is negative four.
Next, inside the brackets, multiplication comes before addition. Four times negative four is negative sixteen.
Now add inside the brackets. Two plus negative sixteen is negative fourteen.
The bracket is done, so multiply. Three times negative fourteen is negative forty-two.
Finally, negative forty-two minus seven is negative forty-nine.
So the answer is negative forty-nine.
Watch out for these traps. If you square the whole five minus three, you get forty-seven. If you break the bracket into pieces, you get negative seventy-nine.
